calls.reason: The packet has no OpenAI compute-demand share at any provider. Microsoft's Q4 call says almost 90% of cloud revenue came from outside frontier labs, but revenue is not compute demand, so this is too thin to call either way.

This is a conditional forecast about what follows an OpenAI collapse, and no collapse has happened. SoftBank's October 1 release shows it completing a $30B follow-on investment, not reacting to a failure.

Evidence is mixed. Amazon's free cash flow turned negative, which fits the strain point. But OpenAI's March round drew many other institutions, and nothing shows other investors were unavailable in August.
The claim covers OpenAI's financing needs through 2030. The packet shows only the $122B committed in March 2026, and says nothing about funding received in later years or whether OpenAI survives.

No court, regulator or company finding says Nadella misled investors, and the class action is pending and about Azure growth. Microsoft gave growth figures that exclude OpenAI and its share of backlog, which weakens the charge without settling it.

Anthropic's S-1 shows a $0.69B first-half 2026 operating loss and positive operating cash flow, against about $21.6B for OpenAI (WSJ). So 'just as unprofitable' fails, even though its $518B in commitments counts as hundreds of billions.
